input_payload.task: Phase 2: Template System + Playwright Renderer — create src/holus/visual/ package

summary: Created src/holus/visual/ package: PlaywrightEngine (async context manager with browser reuse, render_png/render_pdf/render_spec/render_carousel), TemplateEngine (Jinja2 loader with brand CSS injection), BrandVisualIdentityLoader (YAML config to CSS variables), Pydantic models (RenderSpec, RenderResult, SlideSpec, CarouselSpec). Templates: base.html.j2, single_image/insight.html.j2, carousel/hook_slide.html.j2, body_slide.html.j2, cta_slide.html.j2. Styles: base.css, slide.css (1080x1350 safe zones), single.css. Tests: 54 unit tests across 4 test files covering models, brand loading/caching, template rendering with brand injection, and engine with mocked Playwright. Added jinja2>=3.1.0 dependency.
